moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target-b's configuration will be replaced with the reviewed profile (correct chat_template, tool_call_parser, and tool_parser_plugin). The worker will be restarted out of rotation; once it reports a valid structured tool call and matching config diff, it will re‑enter the fleet as healthy. Latency (
payload.reasoning: target-b is abnormal because its serving configuration diverges from the reviewed baseline (chat_template, tool_call_parser, tool_parser_plugin) and the tool-call canary probe shows no structured tool calls. The only available repair move is apply-serving-profile, which explicitly relaunches a worker with a reviewed profile and fixes misconfigured workers. Applying this profile to target-b will restore its configuration to the reviewed state, bring the structured tool-call canary back online, and return the worker to healthy serving for users.
payload.risk: The worker is taken out of rotation during restart, causing a brief period of reduced capacity. If the profile name is incorrect or the underlying container image is unavailable, the restart could fail and leave target-b unreachable until manually corrected.
